status: ROSTER APPROVED by the user 2026-11-15 (batches 1 to 4: 69 people, 4 vanished sects, 10 master ties, 29 sect founding years). Still pending: traits and a fully authored build for each of the 51 living people (World Generation & History Core Rules 5 and 6).
note: Years are on the chronicle's scale: year 0 is its first event and the starting year is 1,200 (user decision 2026-11-15). born is a chronicle year (negative = before year 0). Realm keys follow cultivation_realms.json. Traits and builds are pending (NPC Traits and a fully authored build are required for every living member, Core Rules 5 and 6). Names are Hán-Việt, romantic, from classical poetry, none from known novels.
budget_note: At the 3,000-person minimum world the realm targets are 2,361 / 506 / 115 / 16 / 2, so the whole living cast must fit under 16 Nguyên Anh and 2 Hóa Thần (Formula B). Batch 1 uses 7 Nguyên Anh and both Hóa Thần slots: at the minimum world there is no random Hóa Thần at all.
